title: The Eyewitness Who Did Not See
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Kogoro Mouri, Ran, Takagi) omitted by convention; Ayumi and Genta are kept as person nodes because their witness testimony (the clock sighting and the back-door alibi) is load-bearing to the mystery mechanism, not incidental. No `event` node type: every action is a directly typed edge between the entities involved. Discrepancy vs. the old cases/ file: the old file's motive text says Ebihara's betrayal caused 'Noda's wife to worry herself into suicide' -- the transcript (line ~345) states she 'developed neurosis' from the loan-shark threats, not suicide; corrected here. The old file also flattened the mystery to a single 'dart thrown from the alley outside' theory -- that theory is actually Kogoro's mistaken first read of the scene (a red herring baked into the staging), not the solution; the real mechanism is a locked-room/impersonation trick (Noda posed as Ebihara when Kogoro walked in, then swapped places with the body using the swim-school bus noise as cover) resolved via a clock-position paradox (the shop clock Ayumi saw through the window from outside is not visible from that same spot once Noda's replacement clock is up, proving the clock -- and the 'corrected' 5:50->6:10 reading built on it -- was swapped after her sighting, which clears Shimazaki/Koike and points at the only person who could have swapped it: the clock-shop-owning customer, Noda). case_type: murder.
